description: This file defines a static class for diagnostics related to implicit field ID generation failures in the Orleans code generator, including constants for diagnostic IDs, titles, messages, and a method to create diagnostic instances.

classes.name: CanNotGenerateImplicitFieldIdsDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class providing diagnostic constants and a method to create diagnostics related to implicit field ID generation failures.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object indicating failure to generate implicit field identifiers for a given symbol, including the reason.
